title: When 3D Gaussian Splatting Recovers Real Surfaces
abstract: arXiv:2608.30054v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When does 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) recover the true scene surface rather than just overfitting view-dependent appearance? We answer this by developing a mathematical framework based on a first-hit rendering abstraction that cleanly isolates geometry from appearance. We prove that geometric misalignment forcefully converts spatial textures into high-frequency angular signals via parallax. This establishes a strict identifiability window: if angular capacity is bounded, surface-consistent solutions are mathematically preferred; if unrestricted, the same images can be perfectly explained by an incorrect, opaque billboard geometry. Experiments on synthetic stress tests confirm this prediction, showing billboard failures emerge precisely at high angular capacities. translated_title: 3D高斯泼溅何时能恢复真实表面
translated_abstract: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）何时能够恢复场景的真实表面，而不仅仅是对视角相关的外观进行过拟合？我们通过建立一个基于“首次命中渲染”抽象的数学框架来回答这一问题，该框架清晰地将几何与外观分离。我们证明了几何错位会通过视差效应强行将空间纹理转换为高频角度信号。这确立了一个严格的可辨识性窗口：如果角度容量是有界的，则与表面一致的解在数学上是被优先选择的；如果角度容量不受限制，同样的图像也可以被错误的、不透明的广告牌式几何完美解释。在合成压力测试上的实验证实了这一预测，表明广告牌式失败恰好出现在高角度容量的情况下。相反，在采用标准采集协议评估的真实世界数据集中，即使在高阶球谐函数下，重建结果仍然保持与表面一致，这与……
tldr: 本文提出基于首次命中渲染的数学框架，证明3DGS只有在角度容量受限时才能在数学上保证恢复真实表面，而角度容量不受限时，同一组图像可被错误的广告牌式几何完美解释。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a mathematical framework based on a first-hit rendering abstraction, proving that 3DGS recovers true surfaces only when angular capacity is bounded, while unrestricted capacity can perfectly explain the same images with incorrect, opaque billboard geometry.
